title: M-APSK Modulator Baseband
text: M -ary amplitude phase shift keying (APSK) modulation, 1 input, 1 output, {Symbol mapping} sets Symbol mapping; {Constellation points per circle} sets the constellation points per PSK ring, {Radius of each circle} sets the radius per PSK ring, {Phase offset of each circle (rad)} sets the phase offset per PSK ring, {Custom symbol mapping}, {Input type}, {Output data type}, {View Constellation} plots reference constellation and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: APSK modulated signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Constellation points per circle
params.values: Constellation points per PSK ring [4,12] (default) | vector

params.name: Phase offset of each circle (rad)
params.values: Phase offset per PSK ring [pi/4,pi/12] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Symbol mapping
params.values: Symbol mapping Auto (default) | Contourwise-gray | Gray | User-defined

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
